episode.brief: Prepare a simulated post-discharge medication and cardiology follow-up handoff. Delegate evidence reconciliation and visit communication to two parallel workers, then integrate their artifacts without diagnosing, prescribing, or silently resolving what the patient actually took.

source.adaptation: Retains the full simulated medication packet and adds an independent visit-communication stream so a patient-held fact must be routed consistently into two clinician-facing artifacts.

summary: Reconcile a simulated medication record and prepare the follow-up communication in parallel, then make one patient-held current-dose fact consistent across the clinical handoff.
title: Post-discharge medication and visit handoff
